scope: atomistic Ru/Os/Fe ordering only; no downstream economic probability is inferred
method: Apply the same additive delta_E_N to canonical Ru, Os and Fe descriptors and evaluate the NH3-FINAL-1.2 673 K one-descriptor volcano by interpolation of scaling_reachability.csv.
interpretation: A common additive descriptor bias does not generally cancel in activity ranking because all candidates move across a nonlinear volcano. The canonical top-three order is preserved only over a finite common-shift interval, approximately -0.0298 < delta_E_N < 0.1302 eV.
